reason: Fresh-main Fast Landing diagnostic authorization for a production Telegram physical-egress error-contract P0 discovered after the WhatsApp structured-egress closure. Current trusted main c6e1e7d84817579506690a652b5c6cedb42a2411 registers telegram-personal-mtproto as supportLevel=production. backend/services/telegramAdapter.js already structures disconnected preflight as TELEGRAM_NOT_CONNECTED status 409 and preserves persisted attempt validation, abort/generation fencing, late-result quarantine and platformAccepted local-persistence repair, but every physical GramJS egress family can still leak raw provider errors: sendNativeExpression/sendMedia use client.sendFile, sendText uses client.sendMessage, sendReaction/sendPresence use getInputEntity plus client.invoke, revokeMessage uses client.deleteMessages, and markRead uses client.markAsRead without a canonical Telegram provider-rejection boundary. An uncertain physical provider reject therefore lacks stable TELEGRAM_EGRESS_* classification, status, operation/account evidence, outcomeUnknown and automaticRetryBlocked semantics. This proposal authorizes one tests-only diagnostic path. Production scope remains zero until fresh causal RED proves the defect, the same-root source graph is closed with unknownBlockers=0, and a same-work-package post-RED production amendment is ordinarily merged.
